module: M11, restore preview and capacity checks

observations: Actual Pi created the sample HTML and PPTX using intercepted synthetic SSE; the fixture approved the current document permission and the actual bundle.
Explicit restore activation and cold launch kept source files, original DB bytes, and session/event bindings intact.
The restored PPTX preview opened and the offline HTML control still worked.

Fixture waited for a bundle while the original runtime was waiting for its visible one-time filesystem approval. The test was updated to make that approval; production permission behavior is unchanged.

independent.result: Matched the main artifact hash, read the 1366×768 screenshot and both full/portable restore receipts. The screenshot showed 8 files, 2.8 MiB logical bytes, 18.8 MiB minimum and 120.39 MiB at that observation. Button visibility was verified in the screenshot; actual interaction is covered in the Electron test.

performance.mode: One same-worktree isolated run, 2,920,448-byte synthetic DB

limitations: Real capacity on the target-volume ready branch; simulated capacity for the insufficient branch; no deliberate full-disk test.

The local host is CoreCountrySpecific build 26200; no clean independent Windows guest or installed candidate was used. QG-09, signed release, program upgrade/rollback and cross-PC migration remain open.
The minimum estimate includes file lengths and 16 MiB headroom. It does not account for post-restore indexing, filesystem allocation or all future SQLite writes.
rollback: Revert the commit. Existing backup and recovery receipt formats, the previously selected workspace, and copies already prepared remain readable.
